sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2006 Lamborghini Gallardo Coupe, finished in Grigio Proteus with a black interior. The odometer currently displays approximately 34,900 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies. A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes 19-inch wheels, a front-axle lift system, a transparent engine cover, leather upholstery, heated and power-adjustable seats, air conditioning, and a rearview camera. Notable modifications reported by the seller include EBC Red brake pads, Giro brake rotors, K&N air filters, a Fabspeed exhaust system, Bluetooth integration, aftermarket door speakers, and a custom leather-wrapped subwoofer box. Power comes from a 5.0-liter V10, rated at 493 horsepower and 376 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via a 6-speed “E-Gear” automated manual transmission.

sections.Seller Notes: Due to the modifications performed to this Lamborghini, it may not pass emissions testing in some states. As always, it's the buyer’s responsibility to perform all due diligence regarding registering this Gallardo in their respective state prior to placing a bid. The seller reports that the replacement engine showed approximately 26,000 miles at the time of installation. Photos and information documenting the engine replacement process are provided in the gallery. The seller reports that the windows of this Gallardo have been tinted.
